# Multispectral Sentinel-2-like Small

A tiny four-band uint16 multispectral scene approximating a Sentinel-2 band stack (blue, green, red, NIR). Exercises multispectral band handling and a sentinel NoData value of 0.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Case ID | `multispectral_s2_like_small` |
| Category | raster |
| Format | GeoTIFF |
| CRS | `EPSG:32633` |
| Test tier | integration |
| Size class | tiny |
| Storage class | bundled |
| Redistributable | yes |
| Loader | `rasterio` |
| Status | validated |

## Use this case

```python
import pytest


@pytest.mark.geocase_case("multispectral_s2_like_small")
def test_multispectral_s2_like_small(geocase_case) -> None:

    assert data is not None
```

## What this case checks

Confirm GeoCase preserves a four-band uint16 multispectral stack, its band ordering, and its sentinel NoData convention.

## Risk types covered

- [`band_loss`](../risk/band-loss.md)
- [`dtype_drift`](../risk/dtype-drift.md)
- [`incorrect_band_order`](../risk/incorrect-band-order.md)
- [`nodata_ignored`](../risk/nodata-ignored.md)
